mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates labor market stress, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic uncertainty increases.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline, SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and earnings growth.
failure_condition: In periods of INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually, SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth above 3.0% annually), S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 growth above 3.0% annually, SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing production and housing starts indicate a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investment and consumption weaken.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline, SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
